mapper.select:
SELECT w.withdrawal_id AS id, w.user_id, u.email, u.name, w.reason, w.reason_text, w.requested_at, w.purge_after, w.canceled_at, w.canceled_by, w.purged_at, w.purged_by FROM tb_user_withdrawal w LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_id = w.user_id
ORDER BY w.requested_at DESC, w.withdrawal_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM tb_user_withdrawal w LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_id = w.user_id

SELECT count(*) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE w.canceled_at IS NULL AND w.purged_at IS NULL) AS open, count(*) FILTER (WHERE w.canceled_at IS NOT NULL) AS canceled, count(*) FILTER (WHERE w.purged_at IS NOT NULL) AS purged FROM tb_user_withdrawal w WHERE w.requested_at >= #{from}
SELECT w.reason, count(*) AS count FROM tb_user_withdrawal w WHERE w.requested_at >= #{from} GROUP BY w.reason ORDER BY count(*) DESC, w.reason
